title: Food Tier List
description: Rebalances Minecraft's food economy by separating foods into "tiers" based on complexity and player interaction.
body:
### Food Tier List
![Obese, unkempt Gumball Watterson wears a gaming headset and speaks passionately into the audience's POV](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e37cfe933883b6284a0ad4366b1ab09e2039e511.jpeg)

WHAT’S UP EVERYONE, today, we will rank EVERY FOOD ITEM available in Minecraft, ‘cause frankly, some of these foods are COMPLETE FRAUDS. WHY THE HELL does eating seven berries I found while on my knees in a cave satiate me more than an ENTIRE steak. MOJANG, PLEASE FIX MINECRAFT OR SOMETHING. So anyways, I spent 14 consecutive hours calculating hunger values instead of taking a shower. Before we continue, remember to OBLITERATE that like button, hit subscribe, hit that notification bell, and comment your favorite food in Minecraft. *sniffles* Personally, I would consider myself a Golden Carrot supremacist. 

On a more serious note, Food Tier List attempts to rebalance Minecraft’s food economy into a clearer progression system. Foods are balanced into a tier system grouped by effort, processing, and interaction, attempting to, at least slightly, stop players from permanently relying on easy to obtain food.

### Supported Versions
This mod currently supports the Fabric modloader, with upcoming support for NeoForge.

### Tierlist![TierMaker Tier list that separates each Minecraft food into groups based on hunger restored from highest to lowest.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d039eddae4192e96f8739e1684a9df72f4af5d5.png)
